question:
The Battle of Karnal is known for the invasion of which of the following aggressors against India?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: Nadir Shah
Nasir Khan
Ahmad Shah Abdali
Shah Shuja
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Nadir Shah

Explanation:
The Battle of Karnal (1739) is a significant event in Indian history, known for the invasion by the Persian ruler Nadir Shah. This battle was fought between the Mughal Emperor Muhammad Shah Rangila and Nadir Shah. Nadir Shah defeated the Mughal army and captured Delhi. As a result of this battle, Nadir Shah looted enormous wealth and precious items from the Mughal Empire, including the famous Koh-i-Noor diamond and the Peacock Throne.

Extra Facts:
Nadir Shah is also called the 'Napoleon of Persia'. His invasion exposed the weakness of the Mughal Empire. After this battle, the decline of the Mughal Empire accelerated. Nadir Shah also carried out a brutal massacre in Delhi, known as the Sack of Delhi (1739).

question_hi:
करनाल का युद्ध भारत के विरुद्ध निम्नलिखित में से किस आक्रमणकारी के आक्रमण के लिए जाना जाता है?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options_hi: नादिर शाह
नासिर खान
अहमद शाह अब्दाली
शाह शुजा
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है नादिर शाह

Explanation:
करनाल का युद्ध (1739) भारतीय इतिहास में एक महत्वपूर्ण घटना है जो फारसी शासक नादिर शाह के आक्रमण के लिए जाना जाता है। यह युद्ध मुगल सम्राट मुहम्मद शाह रंगीला और नादिर शाह के बीच लड़ा गया था। नादिर शाह ने इस युद्ध में मुगल सेना को पराजित किया और दिल्ली पर कब्जा कर लिया। इस युद्ध के परिणामस्वरूप, नादिर शाह ने मुगल साम्राज्य से भारी मात्रा में धन और कीमती वस्तुएं लूटीं, जिसमें प्रसिद्ध कोहिनूर हीरा और मयूर सिंहासन भी शामिल थे।

Extra Facts:
नादिर शाह को 'फारस का नेपोलियन' भी कहा जाता है। उसने भारत पर आक्रमण करके मुगल साम्राज्य की कमजोरी को उजागर किया। इस युद्ध के बाद मुगल साम्राज्य का पतन तेजी से शुरू हो गया। नादिर शाह ने दिल्ली में भीषण नरसंहार किया, जिसे दिल्ली की लूट (1739) के नाम से जाना जाता है।

question:
The mausoleum of the Taj Mahal was designed by _________________.

[SSC MTS 2023]
options:
Bhaktiyar Lahori

Mohammad Isha

Shah Jahan

Ustad Ahmad Lahori
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ustad Ahmad Lahori

Explanation:
The mausoleum of the Taj Mahal was designed by Ustad Ahmad Lahori. He was a renowned architect of Mughal architecture and designed several significant structures during Shah Jahan's reign. The Taj Mahal was constructed between 1632 and 1653 and is considered the finest example of Mughal architecture. It was built by Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

Extra Facts:
The Taj Mahal was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983. It is made of white marble and showcases a blend of Persian, Islamic, and Indian architectural styles. Around 20,000 laborers and artisans worked on its construction.

question_hi:

[SSC MTS 2023]
options_hi:
भक्तियार लाहौरी

मोहम्मद ईशा

शाहजहां

उस्ताद अहमद लाहौरी
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है उस्ताद अहमद लाहौरी

Explanation:
ताजमहल के मकबरे की रूपरेखा उस्ताद अहमद लाहौरी द्वारा तैयार की गई थी। उस्ताद अहमद लाहौरी मुगल वास्तुकला के प्रसिद्ध शिल्पकार थे और उन्होंने शाहजहाँ के शासनकाल में कई महत्वपूर्ण इमारतों का निर्माण किया। ताजमहल को 1632 से 1653 के बीच बनाया गया था और यह मुगल वास्तुकला का सर्वोत्कृष्ट उदाहरण माना जाता है। इसका निर्माण शाहजहाँ ने अपनी पत्नी मुमताज महल की याद में करवाया था।

Extra Facts:
ताजमहल को यूनेस्को द्वारा 1983 में विश्व धरोहर स्थल घोषित किया गया था। इसका निर्माण सफेद संगमरमर से किया गया है और इसमें फारसी, इस्लामिक और भारतीय वास्तुकला का मिश्रण देखने को मिलता है। ताजमहल के निर्माण में लगभग 20,000 मजदूरों और कारीगरों ने काम किया था।

question:
Who among the following wrote a history of Akbar's reign titled Akbar Nama?

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options: Miya Tansen
Todar Mal
Raja Birbal
Abul Fazl
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Abul Fazl

Explanation:
Abul Fazl authored the Akbar Nama, a detailed history of Mughal Emperor Akbar's reign. Written in Persian, this monumental work chronicles Akbar's life, policies, administrative reforms, and cultural achievements. Abul Fazl was one of Akbar's Navratnas (Nine Jewels) and also composed the Ain-i-Akbari, a part of Akbar Nama, which provides insights into the Mughal administration, land revenue system, and socio-economic conditions.

Extra Facts:
The Akbar Nama is divided into three volumes—the first covers Akbar's ancestors and early life, the second details his reign, and the third is the Ain-i-Akbari. Abul Fazl spent nearly seven years compiling this text, which remains a vital source for Mughal history.

question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से किसने अकबर के शासनकाल का इतिहास लिखा था जिसका शीर्षक अकबरनामा है?

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options_hi: मिया तानसेन
टोडरमल
राजा बीरबल
अबुल फजल
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है अबुल फजल

Explanation:
अबुल फजल ने अकबरनामा नामक ग्रंथ की रचना की, जो मुगल सम्राट अकबर के शासनकाल का विस्तृत इतिहास है। यह ग्रंथ फारसी भाषा में लिखा गया था और इसमें अकबर के जीवन, उसकी नीतियों, प्रशासनिक सुधारों तथा सांस्कृतिक उपलब्धियों का वर्णन है। अबुल फजल अकबर के दरबार के नौ रत्नों में से एक थे और उन्होंने ऐन-ए-अकबरी नामक एक अन्य महत्वपूर्ण ग्रंथ भी लिखा, जो अकबरनामा का ही एक भाग है और इसमें मुगल साम्राज्य के प्रशासन, भूमि राजस्व, सामाजिक-आर्थिक स्थिति आदि का विवरण मिलता है।

Extra Facts:
अकबरनामा को तीन भागों में विभाजित किया गया है - पहला भाग अकबर के पूर्वजों और उनके बचपन के बारे में है, दूसरा भाग उनके शासनकाल के विभिन्न पहलुओं को समर्पित है, और तीसरा भाग ऐन-ए-अकबरी है। अबुल फजल ने इसे लिखने में लगभग सात वर्ष का समय लिया और यह मुगल इतिहास का एक प्रमुख स्रोत माना जाता है।

question:
Which Mughal monument was built by the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb in the memory of his wife, Dilras Banu Begum?

[SSC MTS ]
options:
Taj Mahal

Humayun tomb

Rani Ki Vav

Bibi Ka Maqbara
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bibi Ka Maqbara

Explanation:
The Bibi Ka Maqbara was commissioned by the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb in 1661 in memory of his first wife, Dilras Banu Begum (also known as Rabia-ud-Daurani). Located in Aurangabad, Maharashtra, it is often referred to as the 'Taj of the Deccan'. Although it resembles the Taj Mahal, it is less grand and reflects the declining artistic splendor of the Mughal Empire. The tomb was designed by Ata-ullah, the son of Ustad Ahmad Lahori, the chief architect of the Taj Mahal.

Extra Facts:
Aurangzeb constructed several monuments during his reign, but Bibi Ka Maqbara stands out as a personal tribute. Dilras Banu Begum died in 1657, prompting Aurangzeb to build this mausoleum. It symbolizes the later phase of Mughal architecture, marked by reduced opulence compared to earlier monuments like the Taj Mahal.

question_hi:
किस मुगल स्मारक का निर्माण मुगल बादशाह औरंगजेब ने अपनी पत्नी दिलरस बानो बेगम की स्मृति में करवाया था?

[SSC MTS ]
options_hi:
ताजमहल

हुमायूँ का मकबरा

रानी की वावी

बीबी का मकबरा
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है बीबी का मकबरा

Explanation:
बीबी का मकबरा का निर्माण मुगल बादशाह औरंगजेब ने अपनी पहली पत्नी दिलरस बानो बेगम (जिन्हें राबिया-उद-दौरानी भी कहा जाता है) की याद में 1661 ईस्वी में करवाया था। यह मकबरा औरंगाबाद, महाराष्ट्र में स्थित है और इसे 'दक्कन का ताजमहल' भी कहा जाता है। यह स्मारक मुगल वास्तुकला का एक उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है, हालांकि यह ताजमहल की तुलना में कम भव्य है। इसका डिज़ाइन अता-उल्लाह (ताजमहल के वास्तुकार उस्ताद अहमद लाहौरी के पुत्र) ने तैयार किया था।

Extra Facts:
औरंगजेब ने अपने शासनकाल में कई स्मारक बनवाए, लेकिन बीबी का मकबरा उनकी निजी भावनाओं को दर्शाता है। दिलरस बानो बेगम की मृत्यु 1657 ईस्वी में हुई थी, जिसके बाद औरंगजेब ने इस मकबरे का निर्माण शुरू करवाया। यह मुगल साम्राज्य के पतन के दौर का एक महत्वपूर्ण स्मारक है, जो मुगलों की घटती कलात्मक भव्यता को भी दर्शाता है।

question:
The Rohtas Fort is located in present day_______

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]
options: Pakistan
India
Bangladesh
Nepal
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pakistan

Explanation:
The Rohtas Fort is located in present-day Punjab province of Pakistan. It was built by Sher Shah Suri between 1541-1548 CE. The fort was constructed primarily to suppress the rebellion of the Gakhar tribe and to prevent the Mughal emperor Humayun from returning to India. Known for its massive walls and military significance, it is also a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Extra Facts:
Rohtas Fort is also called Qila Rohtas. Situated near the Indus River, its architecture reflects a blend of Hindu and Islamic styles. Sher Shah Suri built it so strong that it was never conquered in a direct battle.

भारत
बांग्लादेश
नेपाल
solution_hi:

Explanation:
रोहतास का किला वर्तमान में पाकिस्तान के पंजाब प्रांत में स्थित है। यह किला शेरशाह सूरी ने 1541-1548 ईस्वी के बीच बनवाया था। इसका निर्माण मुख्य रूप से गक्खर जनजाति के विद्रोह को रोकने और मुगल सम्राट हुमायूँ को वापस भारत आने से रोकने के लिए किया गया था। यह किला अपनी विशाल दीवारों और सैन्य महत्व के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। यह यूनेस्को की विश्व धरोहर स्थल में भी शामिल है।

Extra Facts:
रोहतास किले को किला-ए-रोहतास भी कहा जाता है। यह सिंधु नदी के किनारे स्थित है और इसकी वास्तुकला में हिंदू और इस्लामिक शैली का मिश्रण देखने को मिलता है। शेरशाह सूरी ने इस किले को इतना मजबूत बनवाया कि यह कभी भी सीधे हमले में नहीं जीता गया।

question:
Who among the following took the title of ‘Ghazi’ after defeating Rana Sanga in the Battle of Khanwa in 1527?

[SSC MTS ]
options: Babur
Daulat Khan Lodhi
Humayun
Mahmud Shah I
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Babur

Explanation:
After defeating Rana Sanga in the Battle of Khanwa (1527), Babur assumed the title of 'Ghazi' (warrior for Islam). Extra Facts:

question:
Who among the following was given the charge of looking after the imperial household during the Mughal administration?

solution:

Explanation:
In the Mughal administration, Mir Saman was given the charge of looking after the imperial household. Extra Facts:
Other key administrative posts in the Mughal Empire included Mir Bakshi (in charge of military administration and salary distribution), Diwan-i-Ala (finance minister), and Sadr-us-Sudur (head of religious affairs). The Mughal administrative system was highly structured, with clearly defined responsibilities for each position.

question:
Which Mughal prince translated the Upanishads into Persian in 1657?

[SSC CGL 2020]
options: Sultan Luftallah
Dara Shikoh
Murad Mirza
Shah Suja
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dara Shikoh

Explanation:
In 1657, Mughal prince Dara Shikoh translated the Upanishads into Persian under the title 'Sirr-e-Akbar' (The Great Secret). Dara Shikoh was the eldest son of Shah Jahan and the brother of Aurangzeb. He sought to establish harmony between Hindu and Islamic philosophies, believing that the Upanishads' concept of monotheism aligned with Islamic 'Tawhid' (oneness of God). This translation later reached European scholars, who further translated it into Latin and other languages, introducing Indian philosophy to the Western world.

Extra Facts:
Dara Shikoh also authored 'Majma-ul-Bahrain' (The Confluence of Two Oceans), comparing Hindu and Sufi ideologies. He was deeply influenced by Sufism and was a disciple of Mulla Shah Badakhshi. In 1659, Aurangzeb executed him on charges of heresy due to his liberal religious views.

question:
Who among the following was the successor of Mughal emperor Shahjahan to the throne ?

solution:

Explanation:

In 1657, Shah Jahan fell ill, leading to a fierce war of succession known as the 'War of Succession'. Aurangzeb defeated his brothers, captured power in 1658, and imprisoned Shah Jahan in Agra Fort. He declared himself emperor with the title 'Alamgir' in 1658.

Extra Facts:
Aurangzeb (1658-1707) was the last great ruler of the Mughal Empire, reigning for nearly 50 years. He reimposed the Jizya tax and adopted a policy of destroying Hindu temples. During his rule, the Mughal Empire reached its territorial peak, but his orthodox policies led to widespread discontent.

question:

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]

Explanation:
'Teen Darwaza' is a historical monument located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. It was built in 1415 AD by Sultan Ahmed Shah and is an excellent example of Gujarat Sultanate architecture. It was primarily constructed as an entrance gate for the royal family. This monument is situated near the historic market 'Manek Chowk' in Ahmedabad and is considered a cultural heritage of Gujarat.

Extra Facts:
Teen Darwaza derives its name from its three arches (darwazas). It is a fine example of Indo-Islamic architecture and is one of the major tourist attractions in Ahmedabad. Nearby, other historical sites like the Sidi Saiyyed Mosque and Jama Masjid are also located.

question:
When was Khandesh merged into the Mughal empire by Akbar ?

[SSC CPO 2023]

Explanation:
Akbar merged Khandesh into the Mughal Empire in 1601 CE after defeating its ruler, Miran Bahadur Shah. Khandesh was a significant kingdom in the Deccan region, and its annexation provided the Mughals with a strategic foothold in South India. This was part of Akbar’s 'Deccan Policy', aimed at expanding Mughal influence over the Deccan Sultanates like Ahmadnagar, Bijapur, and Golconda. The capital of Khandesh, Burhanpur, became an important Mughal administrative and military center.

Extra Facts:
Although Khandesh came under Mughal control during Akbar’s reign, it was fully consolidated under Aurangzeb. Akbar’s Deccan campaigns were crucial for Mughal expansion, but conflicts with regional powers continued. The annexation of Khandesh also facilitated trade and military movements between North and South India.

question:

Explanation:
The Battle of Haldighati was fought on 18 June 1576 between Maharana Pratap of Mewar and the Mughal forces of Emperor Akbar. The battle took place at Haldighati, a mountain pass in the Aravalli Range of Rajasthan. The Mughal army was led by Man Singh I and Asaf Khan, while Maharana Pratap fought alongside his loyal commander Hakim Khan Sur and Bhil warriors. Although the Mughals claimed victory, Maharana Pratap refused to submit to Akbar and continued guerrilla warfare.

Extra Facts:
The Battle of Haldighati is a significant military conflict in Indian history, symbolizing the struggle for Mewar's independence. Maharana Pratap's horse, Chetak, died in this battle and is remembered as a symbol of bravery. Despite the Mughal victory, Pratap continued his resistance against Akbar.

Explanation:
